before_times: Which visit: a first consult, a follow-up, or a coach visit?
Will a plan pay? Just its name here.
Is it for a child? (yes or no here; a parent or guardian books and stays)
after_time: Anything that helps the visit, like a step-free way in, an interpreter, or a coach who speaks the patient's language.
Would you like a woman or a man as the practitioner? (asked before anyone else is booked; offered where one is free)
secure_page_only: Date of birth; the plan's member number
The intake form: health history, conditions, medicines and supplements, allergies
Could you be pregnant or breastfeeding? (for anyone who could be)
Who your notes go to: your doctor, or no one
Consent for the plan, and for any remedy the practitioner suggests
intake_questions.who_may_book: An adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child, who stays; a health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a doctor's office for its patient.

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, a stroke sign, or a fainting spell now
stop.say: Call 911 now. A naturopathic visit is not for an emergency.

stop.words: crisis words, or thoughts of harming yourself

go_on.what: no remedy or fasting plan until the practitioner OKs it; the practitioner asks again at the visit

go_on.words: a prescription medicine, or a serious condition such as heart disease, cancer, diabetes, kidney or liver disease
go_on.what: the practitioner reviews it before any remedy is suggested; a change to a prescription comes only from the patient's own doctor
a parent or guardian books and stays; the practice's own rules for children apply

first_steps_and_forms.prep: On a secure link: what to bring (a photo ID, the list of medicines and supplements, the plan card, any food diary the practitioner asked for).

required.name: Intake form
required.who: the patient, on the secure page
required.result: the practitioner reads it before the visit; a flag moves the visit to the practitioner

required.name: Health history and medicines
required.who: the patient, on the secure page
required.result: the practitioner OKs any remedy before it is suggested

required.name: Doctor's note (where the practice asks for one)
required.result: not in by the day before: the desk calls the doctor's office; still not in, the visit can move with no fee

staff.skills: each person's visit kinds, as the practice lists them
staff.supervision: A remedy decision is the practitioner's alone; a coach gives no medical advice.
staff.who_oks: The practitioner OKs every remedy and any flag; a coach doesn't.
staff.stand_in: Another practitioner or coach with the same skill. A patient who asked for a woman or a man is asked before anyone else is booked; nobody moves on silence.
staff.roles: Naturopathic practitioners (as licensed where the state licenses the work), wellness coaches, and the front desk.

children_and_age.who_may_book: An adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child, who stays; a health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a doctor's office for its patient.
children_and_age.minors_texts: A parent or guardian books; texts go to them.
children_and_age.minors_rules: Who may consent for a child, and what a minor may consent to alone: the practice's own rule, from the state's form.

visit.check_in: The check-in code at the front desk. A video visit: the code is read out at the start.
visit.done: The code, or DONE when the visit ends.
visit.changes_at_visit: A new remedy or a new lab test comes only from the practitioner; the desk never adds one on its own.

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: Optional, and Rosie checks nothing. The practice may list each practitioner's license or credential, where the state licenses the work, and any insurance it carries; Rosie shows what the practice enters, as given.
license.who: The practice; each practitioner; each wellness coach.
license.ask: Optional: each practitioner's license or credential and its end date, as the practice keeps them.
license.insurance: Optional: the practice may list its liability insurance; Rosie does not check it.
license.background: The practice's own choice; Rosie does not run one.

never_in_a_text: The concern, the remedy, the medicine, the test, the reason for the visit, and any health history. Texts name only the practice, the date, the time, the place and a secure link; staff and owner texts use initials.
languages: English and Spanish, plus the practice's interpreter line.
